channel.title: The Party Wheel: Holiday party ideas
channel.description: Spin-the-wheel pickers from The Party Wheel. Feed for the Pinterest board "Holiday Party Ideas".

item.title: White Elephant Gifts Under $10 (That Still Get Stolen)
item.description: Small budget, big laughs. Spin for white elephant gift ideas under $10: fuzzy socks, hot cocoa, a pickle ornament, gross-flavor jelly beans, pocket card games, and more. Each idea links to shop it. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of cheap white elephant gift ideas with the headline White Elephant Gifts Under $10

item.title: Classic Christmas Movies: Spin to Pick an Old Favorite
item.description: Want an old-fashioned Christmas movie night? Spin a free wheel of 13 classics, from It’s a Wonderful Life and Miracle on 34th Street to White Christmas, A Christmas Story, and The Bishop’s Wife. Each pick shows a one-line summary plus where to stream, rent, or buy it. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of classic Christmas movies with the headline Classic Christmas Movie Night

item.title: Office Holiday Party Games for Big Groups: Spin for One
item.description: Planning the office holiday party? Spin a free wheel of 11 holiday games for big groups (13+, play in teams), with no board games to buy: Charades, Fishbowl, Holiday Trivia, Two Truths and a Lie, Pass the Parcel, Holiday Pictionary, and more. Each spin shows quick rules. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of holiday party games for big groups with the headline Office Party Games for Big Groups

item.title: White Elephant Gifts for a $25 Limit: Spin for One
item.description: Office gift exchange with a $20 or $25 limit? Spin for practical white elephant ideas that usually cost $10 to $25: a sherpa throw blanket, an insulated tumbler, a portable phone charger, a mini waffle maker, a hot sauce sampler, and more. Prices vary, so check before you buy. Each idea links to shop it. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of practical white elephant gift ideas with the headline White Elephant Gifts for a $25 Limit

item.title: Family Christmas Movie Night: Spin to Pick a Movie
item.description: Can't agree on a family Christmas movie? Spin a free wheel of kid-friendly picks like Elf, Home Alone, Klaus, The Polar Express, and Arthur Christmas. No PG-13 or R picks, and each pick shows where to stream it. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of family Christmas movies with the headline Family Christmas Movie Night

item.title: Holiday Game Night for 8 to 12 People: Spin for a Game
item.description: Hosting Friendsmas or a family holiday get-together? Spin a free wheel of 17 holiday party games for groups of 8 to 12, mixing no-supply games like Charades and Holiday Trivia with card games like Wavelength, Herd Mentality, and Monikers, plus a White Elephant gift swap. Each spin shows quick rules and a link to how-to-play videos. Free, no sign-up.

media:content.media:description: A spinning wheel of holiday party games for 8 to 12 people with the headline Holiday Game Night for 8 to 12
